title: Pan-Seared Cod with Caramelized Velvety Sauce
description: A delicious and easy-to-make cod dish with a velvety caramelized sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the cod fillets to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through.
Meanwhile, warm the velvety caramelized sauce in a separate saucepan over low heat.
To serve, place a cod fillet on each skewer, spoon some of the warm sauce over the top, and garnish with chopped parsley and a lemon wedge, if desired.
